# Built-in actions for Windows, loaded by the program on Windows (actions.macos.txt on macOS) and
# shown in the GUI. The build copies this file next to the exe; do not edit that copy (it is
# replaced on every build). Bind one with "alt+q = @name" in any config, or define an action of the
# same name in your own config to override it. Keep the names in step with actions.macos.txt.
#
# [action name]
# description: what it does
# category: group name in the GUI (optional)
# step, step        (each step is a key or combo; steps run in order)

# --- Windows and desktops ---

[action switch-window]
description: Switch to the next window (hold Alt to keep cycling)
category: Windows and desktops
alt+tab

[action previous-window]
description: Switch to the previous window
category: Windows and desktops
alt+shift+tab

[action task-view]
description: Open Task View with all windows and desktops
category: Windows and desktops
win+tab

[action close-window]
description: Close the active window
category: Windows and desktops
alt+f4

[action show-desktop]
description: Show or hide the desktop
category: Windows and desktops
win+d

[action lock-screen]
description: Lock the computer
category: Windows and desktops
win+l

[action task-manager]
description: Open Task Manager
category: Windows and desktops
ctrl+shift+esc

[action snap-left]
description: Snap the window to the left half
category: Windows and desktops
win+left

[action snap-right]
description: Snap the window to the right half
category: Windows and desktops
win+right

[action maximize-window]
description: Maximize the window
category: Windows and desktops
win+up

[action minimize-window]
description: Minimize the window
category: Windows and desktops
win+down

[action next-desktop]
description: Switch to the next virtual desktop
category: Windows and desktops
ctrl+win+right

[action previous-desktop]
description: Switch to the previous virtual desktop
category: Windows and desktops
ctrl+win+left

[action new-desktop]
description: Create a new virtual desktop
category: Windows and desktops
ctrl+win+d

# --- Media and browser keys ---
# These send the same keys as a keyboard's media keys, so a combo of yours can stand in for a media
# key your keyboard doesn't report to Windows. None has a default shortcut.

[action volume-up]
description: Raise the volume
category: Media and browser
volumeup

[action volume-down]
description: Lower the volume
category: Media and browser
volumedown

[action mute]
description: Mute or unmute
category: Media and browser
mute

[action play-pause]
description: Play or pause the current media
category: Media and browser
playpause

[action next-track]
description: Next track
category: Media and browser
nexttrack

[action previous-track]
description: Previous track
category: Media and browser
previoustrack

[action stop-media]
description: Stop media playback
category: Media and browser
mediastop

[action browser-back]
description: Browser back
category: Media and browser
browserback

[action browser-forward]
description: Browser forward
category: Media and browser
browserforward

[action browser-refresh]
description: Refresh the page
category: Media and browser
browserrefresh

[action browser-home]
description: Open the browser home page
category: Media and browser
browserhome

[action launch-mail]
description: Open the default mail app
category: Media and browser
launchmail

# --- Launch ---

[action file-explorer]
description: Open File Explorer
category: Launch
win+e

[action run-dialog]
description: Open the Run dialog
category: Launch
win+r

[action screenshot-region]
description: Capture part of the screen (Snipping Tool)
category: Launch
win+shift+s

[action emoji-picker]
description: Open the emoji picker
category: Launch
win+.

[action clipboard-history]
description: Open the clipboard history
category: Launch
win+v

# --- Editing ---

[action copy]
description: Copy the selection
category: Editing
ctrl+c

[action cut]
description: Cut the selection
category: Editing
ctrl+x

[action paste]
description: Paste
category: Editing
ctrl+v

[action paste-plain]
description: Paste without formatting
category: Editing
ctrl+shift+v

[action undo]
description: Undo
category: Editing
ctrl+z

[action redo]
description: Redo
category: Editing
ctrl+y

[action select-all]
description: Select everything
category: Editing
ctrl+a

[action duplicate-selection]
description: Copy the selection and paste it right after
category: Editing
ctrl+c, ctrl+v

# --- Tabs (browsers, editors) ---

[action next-tab]
description: Go to the next tab
category: Tabs
ctrl+tab

[action previous-tab]
description: Go to the previous tab
category: Tabs
ctrl+shift+tab

[action new-tab]
description: Open a new tab
category: Tabs
ctrl+t

[action close-tab]
description: Close the current tab
category: Tabs
ctrl+w

[action reopen-tab]
description: Reopen the last closed tab
category: Tabs
ctrl+shift+t
